|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
* Units may only be damaged by one projectile of ''Blades of Torment'' per cast.
* The ability fires two narrow skillshots, converging at a fixed range. Very small units (''such as [[minion]]s'') can potentially avoid the damage and slow altogether if the blades are fired from a close enough range.
* {{si|Flash}} can be cast during the cast animation of ''Blades of Torment''. If done so, the ability resolves after {{si|Flash}} from the location '''Aatrox''' flashes to.
* Has a width of 150 decreasing as it converges on its max range.
